description: Get income statement, balance sheet, or cash flow statement for one or more stock symbols (comma-separated). A single symbol returns one statement; multiple symbols return a batch plus per-symbol errors.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of GraphQL field names to include; omitted = curated default set

metrics.description: Comma-separated list of line-item metrics to filter to; omitted = all reported metrics

symbols.description: One or more comma-separated ticker symbols (e.g., "AAPL" or "AAPL,MSFT,GOOGL")

name: get_financials
title: Financial Statements
